content:
APPROVED.

Do not stop at planning.

Immediately begin implementation in isolated PRs.

Execution order:

P0-1
Audit the existing registration flow.
Identify every screen, API, database table, authentication path, SMS flow, email flow, validation, and profile dependency.

P0-2
Implement the new Member Registration.

Required fields only:

• First Name
• Last Name
• Date of Birth
• Gender
• Mobile Phone
• Email
• Password
• Confirm Password

Nothing else.

P0-3

After successful registration:

• create member
• verify email/phone
• create session
• redirect to IVX Home

P0-4

Move ALL KYC, AML, SSN, Passport, Driver License, Source of Funds, Bank Verification, Accredited Investor verification, and legal agreements into a completely separate Investor Verification workflow.

Do not request any investor documents during Member Registration.

P0-5

Run deep QA after every repair.

Verify:

• Android
• iOS
• Web
• Expo
• API
• Supabase
• Authentication
• SMS
• Email
• Session persistence

P0-6

Deploy only after all tests pass.

Return after every completed repair ONLY:

• Issue repaired
• Root cause
• Files changed
• Commit SHA
• PR URL
• CI Run
• Render Deployment ID
• Production SHA
• PASS / FAIL

After this registration work is complete, continue automatically with the remaining engineering stabilization backlog until IVX IA and Autonomous reach enterprise production quality.

Do not wait for additional owner instructions between safe repairs.
